name: OpenAgent
description: Self-hosts a personal AI assistant as a single binary that combines 30+ model providers, RAG knowledge bases, MCP tools, and browser and shell agents, for individuals and teams.

skills.name: RAG Knowledge Base
skills.description: Ingests PDFs, Word, and Markdown files into embedded stores and retrieves relevant passages before each answer.

skills.name: MCP Tool Servers
skills.description: Connects agents as an MCP client to any MCP server and routes the model's tool calls to it.

skills.name: Built-In Agent Tools
skills.description: Attaches built-in web search, web browser, and shell tools to an agent for live browsing and command execution.

skills.name: Multi-Provider Chat Assistants
skills.description: Builds chat assistants on any connected model provider, configured per store with its own system prompt.
